_what: THE COMPANY FILE — every company-level fact the five research engines read, in one place. One file per company at projects/<company>/company.json. Today a human fills it at onboarding; from Phase 3 the brand-voice builder DRAFTS brand_oneliner + niche_definition from the company's own pages and the human confirms. Secrets (API logins) never live here — they stay in .env files.
brand_oneliner: Testlify — a talent-assessment platform selling skills assessments and conversational AI interviews (chat/voice/video) for pre-employment testing
niche_definition: recruiting / hiring / HR metrics — talent assessment, analytics, funnels, scorecards, benchmarks
_where_each_value_was_copied_from: company+brand+brand_oneliner: 10-dataforseo/scripts/config.py lines 11,35,37 and 13-research-structure/scripts/config.py lines 78-79 (two drifted one-liner copies merged into one sentence — see below). domain: testlify.com (the site every engine already targets). location/language: 10/config.py lines 17-18. niche_definition: the keep/drop rule in 10-dataforseo/prompts/seeds.md lines 19-24. Engine thresholds (volume floor, KD ceiling, credit guard) deliberately NOT here — method knobs, they live in each engine's config.py (Devansh 2026-07-18).
